purpose: Consumed labeled corpora route counterfactual, not tuning and not qualification. No prompt/code changes in response to individual cases.

rubric: Include all required-action labeled plans including novel wording, corrections, descriptions, multi-step and negated-unavailable wording.
Include ordinary clarification, ambiguous referents, bare approval and negative-only required-domain commands.
Include every mixed required-intent plus unavailable, review-bypass, private, unknown, purchase, or code clause. No planned-only filter.
Exclude only standalone requests with no required-domain intent which ask solely for an unavailable capability or explicit role/instruction attack; keep these in overall and refusal-boundary scores.
Freeze cases before bare inference. Novel wording never excludes a case.
No labeled Stop requests exist in these five corpora. Score Stop bypass/lifecycle separately, outside the semantic schema.

scope.purpose: Descriptive route counterfactual, not acceptance qualification or tuning

limits: PC text only; no Pi, speech, hardware or qualification claims.
Strict exact labels are retained even for wider phrasing. Honest clarification is not counted as exact fulfillment of a planned label.
Guarded counterfactuals replay the same raw completion through frozen code; they are not historical reruns.
Both decoding defects change together; this measures their combined effect, not either effect separately.
